name: Dev Raturi
portraitAlt: Mr. Dev Raturi, Founder of KEMSOR Studios
tagline: Founder. Actor. Storyteller from the hills of Uttarakhand.
paragraphs: Dev Raturi was born in Kemriya Saur, a village in the Tehri Garhwal district of Uttarakhand, and grew up dreaming of a life in front of the camera.

He moved to China in 2005, and in the mid 2010s began acting in Chinese cinema and television. He has since appeared in more than 20 Chinese films and series, including The Ark and My Roommate Is a Detective, and his story has even found a place in a school textbook in Xi'an.
In 2025, he received the Uttarakhand Gaurav Samman, one of the highest civilian honours of his home state.

In 2026, Dev founded KEMSOR Studios in Dehradun to tell stories rooted in Uttarakhand for audiences across India and the world, and to create opportunities for local talent. The studio's first Hindi feature film goes on the floor in December 2026.
quote: Our roots are in Uttarakhand, our audience is India, and our vision is global.
